content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Overview ## slug: payments-set-up-documentlink-overview ## seoTitle: Overview ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End :::(Info) (Is DocumentLink a paid add-on?) No, the DocumentLink feature is included in your Payments package. ::: {{variable.Product_DocumentLink}} renders streamlined, mobile-responsive, and payable invoices on the web that can easily be shared via a link. Itemized {{variable.Object_Invoice}}s can be paid using Blackthorn Payments while remaining PCI Compliant. ![K_01_DocumentLink Overview](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/K_01_DocumentLink%20Overview.png){height="" width=""} Check out our overview of {{variable.Product_DocumentLink}} [here](https://youtu.be/XNibO4ot7pQ){target="_blank"}! ## Authorize To send Invoices from Salesforce via {{variable.Product_DocumentLink}}, you need to authorize {{variable.Product_DocumentLink}} with Blackthorn's Connect App. :::(Warning) (Oauth Link) For the authorization to work properly, you can only be logged into one Salesforce org. ::: ### Production Org Please click the [oauth link](https://auth.blackthorn.io/salesforce?packages=03361000000DksxAAC){target="_blank"} to complete the {{variable.Product_DocumentLink}} setup. ### Sandbox Org {{snippet.DocumentLink_AuthorizeSandbox}} :::(Info) (Did you receive an error?) If you receive an error, view the [DocumentLink Error Codes And Messages](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/documentlink-error-codes-and-messages). :::
